title: 一圈人看她的眼神
summary: Opening wide of the Lu family parlour at night: a ring of seated relatives stares at the young cleaner standing at the near end of the deep long table as if she were a thing on display.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: the parlour of the Lu family home at night, a chandelier overhead pressing warm light onto the rosewood and the polished marble; the long rosewood table runs away from camera along the depth axis with its long side to the lens; 陆蔓 (S8) is seated at the FAR head of the table facing the near end, her back to the side table and the landscape scroll; 陆航 (S14) is perched on the arm of the sofa along the EAST wall at the right of frame; three or four Lu relatives and stewards are ranged one behind another along that same east wall, shoulders all turned to the table axis; 苏小满 (S1) stands at the NEAR end of the table, a half-step left of the centre line, with the cardboard box still hugged in both arms.
[Shot 1] Wide along the depth axis from just inside the near doorway, slightly low: the polished marble floor and the dark red carpet edge fill the bottom of frame, the long table glows warm under the chandelier, and every seated figure has turned its face inward toward the slim cleaner at the near end; nobody sits along the left half of the table.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.600, medium, drifting down the axis: 陆蔓 (S8) at the far head with both hands folded on the table edge, back straight against the side table, eyes on the near end; along the east wall 陆航 (S14) leans back on the sofa arm with one leg crossed over the other.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.600, slow settle on the room: all faces still turned inward down the length of the table, the room holding its breath.
soundscape: The chandelier's faint electric hum, the tick of a long-case clock, silk and wool shifting as the seated family settles, and the crowd's held breath.
music: A low sustained string drone, cold and ceremonial.

title: 抱着纸箱，没有座位
summary: Medium and low-angle on the cleaner: with no chair left for her, she simply stands at the near head of the table hugging the box and looks down the table at the far head seat.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) still stands at the NEAR end of the table a little left of centre, both arms wrapped around the half-worn corrugated box propped on her left forearm, facing the FAR head; 陆蔓 (S8) sits at the far head seat with her eyes on her; the marbled floor and the carpet edge lie in the bottom of frame.
[Shot 1] Medium, slightly low angle: she stands with the box lid up and hugged tight against her chest, the chairs along the table and the sofa arm all occupied, so that the only place left for her is standing.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.400, close on her and the box corner, the box filling the bottom of frame: bare-faced, low ponytail, navy work shirt and grey-blue apron, a staff badge on her chest; her eyes travel down the length of the table and come to rest on the far head.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, cut to the far head: 陆蔓 (S8) sits with her hands folded, watching the near end over the whole length of the table, and nobody offers a chair.
soundscape: The chandelier's hum, the clock, a low murmur of shifting fabric along the east wall, and the box's cardboard creaking once against her forearm.

title: 纸箱放在脚边
summary: Wordless beat: she lowers the box to the floor just behind her right foot, straightens, wipes her palms on the apron and lifts her eyes to the far head of the table.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) stands at the NEAR end of the table holding the box in both arms; 陆蔓 (S8) sits at the far head seat with her eyes on her.
[Shot 1] Medium, high angle looking down over the near end of the table: 苏小满 (S1) bends at the waist and lowers the box, base first, setting it down just behind her right foot against the table leg; the slow movement is unhurried.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.600, close on the floor around the table leg: the box settles onto the marble and she nudges it half a palm further back.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, she straightens, wipes both palms once down her apron and lets her arms hang at her sides, back straight and chin level.
[Shot 4] At 00:08.400, her eyes rise along the depth axis and stop on 陆蔓's (S8) face at the far head of the table; the box stays at her right foot and is never lifted again in this scene.
soundscape: Cardboard scraping once on marble, the clock, the chandelier's hum, a single breath let out across the table.

title: 从大厦里捞上来的？
summary: From the sofa arm the lounging young master fires a drawling question at the far head seat, then sizes the cleaner up from head to foot like goods.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) has just set the box down beside her right foot at the near end and straightened; 陆航 (S14) sits on the arm of the sofa along the EAST wall in the right of frame; 陆蔓 (S8) is at the far head of the table, hands folded.
[Shot 1] Medium from the right side of the table toward the centre axis: 陆航 (S14) sits on the sofa arm with one leg crossed over the other, the loose toe swinging, and slides a sidelong look at 陆蔓 (S8) before he speaks.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.600, closer on 陆航's (S14) face; he speaks in a light drawling Mandarin, grinning: [Chinese] 姐，这就是你从大厦里捞上来的？
[Shot 3] At 00:08.200, he lifts his chin and runs his eyes from her head down to her feet, weighing her the way one weighs merchandise; 苏小满 (S1) stays still at the near end and says nothing.
soundscape: A light drawling young voice, the chandelier's hum, a ripple of shifting silk along the east wall, and the clock.

title: 嘴，放干净点
summary: The old lady at the far head does not turn her head; she presses her folded hands once on the table and corrects him in a flat, slow voice.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 陆蔓 (S8) sits at the far head seat with her hands folded on the table edge and her eyes on the near end; the celadon teacup stands at her right hand.
[Shot 1] Medium at the far head of the table: 陆蔓 (S8) does not turn her head; her eyes stay down the axis, and she presses her folded hands once flat against the table edge.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, close on 陆蔓 (S8): she speaks in a flat slow Mandarin, calm and unhurried: [Chinese] 嘴，放干净点。
[Shot 3] At 00:05.800, tight on the celadon teacup at her right hand with a thread of steam lifting off it; the room stays turned toward the near end and nobody else speaks.
soundscape: A flat slow older voice, the chandelier's hum, a teacup's shallow breath of steam, the clock, and the seated family's held breath.

title: 差着十万八千里
summary: The young master swings his crossed leg the other way, waves a hand past his nose as if driving off a bad smell, and jeers the whole length of the table at her.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 陆航 (S14) sits on the sofa arm at the right of frame; 苏小满 (S1) stands at the near end, hands at her sides.
[Shot 1] Medium on 陆航 (S14): he shifts the crossed leg to the other side and grins wider, one hand waving in front of his nose as if fanning away a smell, his eyes still pinned down the table.
[Shot 2] At 00:01.500, closer as he speaks in a bright jeering Mandarin, and on the last phrase throws one arm out down the axis: [Chinese] 我说实话。脸，是有点像。这气质，差着十万八千里。
[Shot 3] At 00:09.600, along the east wall, one relative shifts a shoulder as if swallowing a laugh; 苏小满 (S1) at the near end does not move.
soundscape: A bright jeering young voice, a smothered swallow of laughter from the east wall, the chandelier's hum, and the clock.

title: 她看着他，没说话
summary: Wordless beat: the cleaner turns a level, unreadable look on the laughing young master for two full seconds, holding her face completely still.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 陆航 (S14) sits back on the sofa arm with his arm still swung out down the axis; 苏小满 (S1) stands at the NEAR end, and the box rests at her right foot.
[Shot 1] Close over 陆航's (S14) shoulder: 苏小满 (S1) fills the near of frame, chin not lowered, her eyes turning levelly onto his face.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.600, tight on her face, held for two full seconds: no tremble in the lashes and no movement at the corner of her mouth; the grin and the east-wall faces behind her are thrown out of focus.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.400, wide along the depth axis, her near and small, him far and lounging, the long table running between them; the room holding its breath.
soundscape: The chandelier's hum, the clock's tick, the east wall's low murmur, and one held breath stretched across the room.

title: 把绳给我看看
summary: The old lady sets her teacup down with one clean click of porcelain, squares herself to the table and points a forefinger at the short red cord at the cleaner's collar.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) stands at the near end with her eyes on the far head seat; 陆蔓 (S8) sits at the far head with the celadon teacup at her right hand.
[Shot 1] Medium at the far head of the table: 陆蔓 (S8) squares her body to the table, picks the celadon teacup up with her right hand and sets it down again with one small clean click of porcelain.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.200, closer; she lifts her hand and points with her forefinger down the axis toward the short red cord at the near figure's collar, then speaks in a low level Mandarin: [Chinese] 把绳给我看看。
[Shot 3] At 00:07.600, tight on 陆蔓's (S8) eyes, travelling first to the near figure's throat before rising to her face; nobody else speaks.
soundscape: One clean click of porcelain on lacquer, a low level older voice, the chandelier's hum, and the clock.

title: 不给
summary: The cleaner answers at once, low and solid, and her hand clamps over her collar to bury the short red cord before she even finishes the two syllables.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 陆蔓 (S8) at the far head has her forefinger raised toward the near figure's collar; 苏小满 (S1) stands at the NEAR end of the table.
[Shot 1] Close on 苏小满 (S1): she answers at once in a low solid voice, and her right hand has already closed over her collar, the backs of her fingers pressing the stand collar down over the short red cord.
[Shot 2] At 00:01.200, on the two syllables, spoken in a low firm Mandarin: [Chinese] 不给。
[Shot 3] At 00:04.200, her eyes go straight back down the table to 陆蔓 (S8) and her hand stays clamped at her collar; nobody else speaks.
soundscape: One low firm voice, cloth pressed under a hand, the chandelier's hum, the clock, and the room's held breath.

title: 挑眉
summary: At the far head the old lady's brows lift a notch and her eyes narrow — she plainly did not expect those two syllables — and she asks it again on a rising hook.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) stands at the near end with her hand clamped at her collar; 陆蔓 (S8) sits at the far head seat with her forefinger still raised.
[Shot 1] Close at the far head: 陆蔓's (S8) brows lift a notch and her eyes narrow, her chin tilting up a hair; she speaks on a rising hooked Mandarin: [Chinese] 嗯？
[Shot 2] At 00:03.400, medium: nothing else in her posture moves, and the rest of the room stays turned toward the near end.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.600, wide along the axis: the seated family, the east wall and the long table all waiting; nobody else speaks.
soundscape: One rising hooked syllable from the far head, the chandelier's hum, the clock's tick, and the seated family leaning in.

title: 我妈给的，谁都不给看
summary: She presses the cord deeper under her collar, drops her hand, and lays down the line evenly, then tilts her chin at the table: whatever there is to say, it can be said across it.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) stands at the near end with her hand still clamped at her collar; 陆蔓 (S8) sits at the far head, watching her; the box rests at her right foot.
[Shot 1] Close on 苏小满 (S1): she presses the cord deeper under her collar, drops her hand back to her side and speaks evenly in a low clear Mandarin, each clause its own step: [Chinese] 我妈给的。谁都不给看。要谈事，就谈事。
[Shot 2] At 00:06.400, she tips her chin half an inch toward the table, meaning that whatever there is to talk about can be talked about on the table.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.600, wide along the axis: she stands straight at the near end with the box at her right foot, and 陆蔓 (S8) watches her from the far head; nobody else speaks.
soundscape: A low clear young voice in the hall, the chandelier's hum, the clock, and a rustle of shifting silk along the east wall.

title: 一声口哨
summary: Wordless beat over a two-second hold: the young master falls back against the sofa and lets out one short bright whistle, as if watching a good show.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) stands at the near end, hand at her side; 陆蔓 (S8) sits at the far head watching her; 陆航 (S14) is on the sofa arm at the right of frame.
[Shot 1] Wide along the depth axis: the chandelier light lies flat on the lacquer of the long table and the room holds for two seconds.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.600, medium on 陆航 (S14): he lets himself fall back against the sofa back, purses his lips and looses one short bright whistle, the tail of it curling upward.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.800, along the east wall two relatives trade half a glance; at the far head 陆蔓 (S8) has not moved and is still watching the near end; 苏小满 (S1) stands still with the box at her foot.
soundscape: One short bright whistle, the chandelier's hum, the clock, a low ripple of shifting silk, and the room's held breath.

title: 坐吧
summary: The old lady lets out one very short laugh that stops at her eyes, re-measures the girl down the table, and offers her a seat in a voice softer than before.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) stands at the near end; 陆蔓 (S8) sits at the far head seat.
[Shot 1] Medium at the far head: 陆蔓 (S8) lets out a very short laugh — the amusement stops at her eyes — and speaks in a Mandarin softer than before: [Chinese] 行。有点意思。坐吧。
[Shot 2] At 00:03.600, she lifts her hand and makes one small open gesture down the axis toward the empty near end of the table.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.600, her eyes have not left the near figure, as if she were re-taking the measure of her; nobody else speaks.
soundscape: A short dry older laugh, a soft older voice, the chandelier's hum, the clock, and the seated family's held breath.

title: 最下首的椅子
summary: Wordless beat: a steward carries a dark wooden chair in and sets it at the very foot of the table, seat facing the far head; the girl turns her head and looks at it.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 陆蔓 (S8) at the far head has just made her small open gesture down the axis; 苏小满 (S1) stands at the near end with the box at her right foot; the near head of the table is empty.
[Shot 1] Medium at the near end: an old steward in a dark uniform comes up from the east wall with short steps, carrying a dark wooden chair in both hands around the foot of the table.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.800, over the near end of the table, looking down: he sets the chair down at the NEAR head, a little left of centre, its back to the door and its seat facing the FAR head seat, then steps back half a pace and stands with his hands at his sides.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.200, 苏小满 (S1) turns her head and looks at the chair set down beside her — the first time in this room that anyone has made a place for her; at the far head 陆蔓 (S8) watches her; nobody speaks.
soundscape: A chair leg scraping once on marble, a steward's soft footfalls, the chandelier's hum, the clock, and the room's held breath.
music: A single low warm piano note.
